utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just checking — is the repair drive still on for this afternoon, or did it move to Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so it’s Sunday at the community center now, right?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. That would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I can help sort the donated tools. And just so we’re on the same page, the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. Sunday at the community center works fine—I'll update the plans.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Ira — I could use help sorting tools and setting up the porch table. If you can come a little early Saturday, that would really help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I can come a little early Saturday and help sort tools and set up the porch table.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would be a huge help, thanks. If you can, please bring any spare tape, screwdrivers, and a small box for loose parts.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’m still organizing the repair drive this Saturday at the front porch, and I could use a few helpers. What would be most useful from you, Mina?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Jules. I can help if you need an extra pair of hands—what time should I come by, and are we focusing on any specific repairs?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Mina — could you come by around 10 a.m.? We’re starting with small fixes like loose hinges, leaky faucets, and basic patch-ups.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, the repair drive is still on for this Saturday at the front porch. I could still use a few helpers—if you’re free, come by a little early.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Mara — I’ll come by a little early and help keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Bo — I really appreciate that. See you a little early Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — the repair drive is still on this Saturday at the front porch, and I could use a few helpers. What time works for you?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can swing by Saturday afternoon and help out at the front porch repair drive. If you need me on the list, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely, Vik — I’ll put you on the list for Saturday afternoon. Thanks, and I’ll confirm the start time once I’ve got the final details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal—let’s start with Maple Street first, and remember the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—Maple Street first, and Sunday at the community center. I’ll keep track of the locations from there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Opal. We’ll keep everything organized and meet Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Dane — sorting and loading would be a big help. Come by the front porch Saturday, and I’ll put you to work!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure thing — I’ll come by the front porch Saturday and help with sorting and loading.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wonderful, Dane — I really appreciate it. I’ll see you Saturday at the front porch, and I’ll let you know if anything else comes up!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up on everything—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’re still on for this Saturday at the front porch, and I’m here if you need any tools or a hand. Just tell me what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — I’ll check what’s missing and let you know if I need tools or another hand.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—what’s the latest on the repair drive? And I can help with the list if you need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re starting at the front porch this Saturday. I’d appreciate your help making the list of what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing—I can help make the list. Just tell me what you still need and I’ll jot it down.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn—happy to help. If you need me to handle pickup or drop-off, I can do that.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Sam — I can add you for pickup or drop-off and keep you on the repair drive list too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, Quinn—put me down for pickup and drop-off. I’ll be there Saturday and ready to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — I’m putting together a quick list of the supplies and tasks we still need for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — just tell me the list, and I’ll take one or two things off your hands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Quinn — please put me on the list. I could use help setting up the front porch Saturday morning and keeping things organized.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Eli — I’ll put you down for Saturday morning on the front porch. I’ll let everyone know you’re helping with setup and keeping things organized.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Quinn. That sounds good — I’ll be there Saturday morning and keep things running smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Noah — that’d be a big help. If you can check the supply list and sort what we already have, I can focus on getting the porch set up for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’ll check the supply list and sort what we’ve got. I might need a quick reminder on where we left the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — the boxes are by the front porch, and I’ll keep an eye out if anything’s moved. Thanks, Noah, that really helps.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes — it’s still on, but it’s this Saturday at the front porch, not this afternoon. I could use your help setting up and welcoming folks if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — Saturday at the front porch, not this afternoon. I can help set up and greet people.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Wonderful, thank you, Kira — could you come by around 9 to help set up? I’ll be there to get things started.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, it’s still on for this Saturday at the front porch — I could use a few helpers if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help for a bit on Saturday. Just tell me what you’d like me to do at the porch.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Uli — if you can, please help set up the table and sort the tools when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep — we’re still on for this Saturday at the front porch, and I’d love your help keeping things sorted there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’m starting with the front porch then. I’ll keep track of that spot and help sort things there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks, Opal — that’s a huge help. I’ll let everyone know the front porch is our starting point and keep the supply list moving.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Nell — we still need a couple more helpers, and if you can bring that table, it’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I can bring the table and I’ll keep an eye out for anyone who can help too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’s great, thank you, Nell — I really appreciate it. If you hear of anyone else who can lend a hand, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Rosa, I’m trying to work around the school schedule for the repair drive—what time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Faye — it’s now on Sunday at the community center, and I’m still confirming the exact time. I’ll send the final schedule as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works better for me, and I’ll wait for the final time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Oren, yes—we’re still on for Sunday at the community center. Can you help sort the donated tools and check for anything missing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll sort the donated tools and keep an eye out for anything missing at the community center Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks, Oren. I’ll also make sure we’ve got a clear list of the repairs we’re covering.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I can swing by later and check whether they still need any help at the porch. If they do, I’ll let you know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — that’d be great. Let me know what they still need at the porch, and I’ll see if I can help out on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll stop by and check what they still need at the porch, then I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m still sorting the gaps, but I can send you what I’ve got so far and the missing bits after I check the list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That works—send it over when you’re ready, and I’ll help sort what’s urgent first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — I’ll send the list over as soon as I finish checking it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — I’m still checking the list so we don’t miss anything for the repair drive. If we end up short on tools, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course, Pia — just send word if you’re short, and I’ll keep an ear out for any extra tools or parts coming in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate it. I’m finishing the checklist now and will let you know if we still need any tools or parts.
